packaging_scope: Measured EVO-X2 64GB runtime changes; target quantization and context capacities retained. Prototypes are marked experimental.

patches.comparison: 2048 to 4096 input batch; two uncached requests each at 8152/16347 tokens: mean prefill 11.689/24.165s to 10.432/21.6275s (10.75/10.50% less time). Two sampled 512-token generation requests per setting: median 40.05 to 38.3 tok/s; output hashes differ, no generation gain established. Available RAM after warm-up at least 8.336 GiB, zero new swap-out pages including reload. Full 128K with browser/vision and broad accuracy unverified.

Two short pairs at 3500MHz/75W: 281/760/4058-token prefill time reduced 24.72/32.01/26.69%. Restarted non-fused/fused decode 38.2/38.1 tok/s with identical output; the original warm process was 40.6 tok/s with different output. CPU peaks around 56C, no swap increase. Broad accuracy and sustained thermals unverified.

Two bounded Flash-Next pairs, 1024 output tokens: CPU peaks 64.0/66.125C to 55.875/56.5C; decode 38.9/39.5 to 40.6/40.6 tok/s. Identical output hashes, zero swap increase. Long-duration thermals and Qwen 27B throughput are unverified; CPU-heavy compilation can slow down.

One uncached 1024-token pair, 25us to 100us: main-thread CPU 42.7% to 21.1% of one logical CPU; total engine CPU 145.1% to 120.6%; decode 34.2 to 34.0 tok/s; zero swap pages. Output hashes differed; no answer-quality or sustained thermal benefit established. Vendor ROCr helper still used about one CPU.
patches.prior_comparison: One matched 1024-token pair: main-thread CPU 99.4% to 42.7% of one logical CPU; total engine CPU 201.0% to 141.2%; decode 35.4 to 35.0 tok/s; identical output hash; zero swap pages. No thermal reduction established.

patches.validation: Built/tested on gfx1151 with ROCm 7.14.60850. Earlier 8 GiB placement skipped snapshots and must not be presented as equivalent-functionality savings. With the 2048 arena and 3.5 GiB cache, 6 GiB placement left 8.434 GiB available; 7 GiB placement left 9.443 GiB versus Nathan 8.658 in these 16K trials. Both retained the two tested histories; all ten Gufo output hashes matched. Some cold requests regressed; no general speed win. Actual 259066-token input plus append passed at 6 GiB placement; a tail revision missed cache and its recomputation was operator-interrupted. 7 GiB filled-context behavior is unverified. No production engine replacement.

Installed RANA projector: 457666560 F16 values are exactly representable in BF16. Bounded in-memory conversion rejects non-finite/non-exact values; original GGUF is unchanged. Independent exhaustive C++/NumPy comparison covered all 65536 F16 bit patterns with zero mismatches. Basic left-red/right-blue image and subsequent text request passed. Broad vision/OCR quality is unverified.

Temporary Qwen workspaces and prompt capture use 2048 tokens rather than 4096; Q6, F16 KV and 262144 context capacity are retained. GPU allocation dropped 0.9995 GiB; minimum OS available RAM improved 9.492->9.742 GiB in matched 6 GiB placement/2 GiB cache trials. Ten same-history outputs matched byte-for-byte, including RAM restoration and basic vision. No decode speed gain established. At 6 GiB placement/3.5 GiB cache, actual 259066-token multimodal input and append passed (1085.044s / 2.333s, minimum available 9.387 GiB); tail revision missed cache and was operator-interrupted. The separate 7 GiB placement trial passed declared streamed tool calls and recovery after stream cancellation. Completed trials had zero new swap-out/OOM. Experimental, not deployed.

Built on gfx1151. Engine upgraded while existing patched Python wrapper remains. Flash 131072/int8 KV retained; bounded cost-MTP qualification covered 128034-token text, append reuse, 129053-token multimodal input and declared streamed tool calls. No new swap-out or OOM in qualification/deployment. Output hashes matched six of seven comparable fixtures in the long-context test; no broad accuracy benchmark. Overlap and numerically different HC/GDN options remain off.

Old/new bounded 16K decode: English seed42 39.6->40.1, seed2718 41.7->43.5; Korean seed42 33.5->35.7, seed2718 35.2->37.8 tok/s. Minimum available RAM 6.489 GiB during long-context/vision qualification. Cache parking is opportunistic and was skipped at the 8 GiB free-memory floor; no multi-conversation latency claim for this deployment. Active context/checkpoint capacity is retained.

patches.comparison: 32 requests: eight predeclared seeds, two workloads, counterbalanced order. Code geomean +5.947%, Korean thinking +2.282%; 5/16 paired regressions. Does not establish +5% slow-condition improvement. Grammar/stateful samplers fall back; full context not qualified.
Fix cleanup metadata surviving temporary buffer release. Actual cleanup-body test fails before and passes after; GPU events are stubs. No live failure or speed/RAM gain demonstrated.

Same arithmetic with shared non-overlapping scratch lifetimes. About 224-248MiB lower anonymous RAM, 176-202MiB better image-phase available-RAM minima. Decode -0.28%/+0.08%, prefill about -0.65%; follow-up image latency +1.1%. No acceleration claim.

configuration_changes.validation: Repeated static sampled comparison, 262K capacity with 16K actual prompts; image and streamed declared-tool tests passed both isolated and production service paths. Target RANA Q6 and F16 KV unchanged. No 262K filled-context trial or guaranteed minimum TPS. Custom cost controller rejected after Korean thinking regressions. Batches 3072/4096 failed Vulkan command submission; 2560 showed no prefill benefit and reduced GTT reserve. Existing 2048 retained.
125K text, append reuse and 126038-token multimodal input passed; no new swap-out or OOM. Cold prefill slower; decode not improved.

validation.validation: Configuration matches the earlier measured 4096 baseline exactly. Engine health and router loaded/idle state checked; no new throughput benchmark in this rollback.

kernel_research_20261025.reason_not_deployed: HC token grouping was bit-exact in the microbenchmark and 256-token sampled outputs matched. At 1024 tokens the English output matched but Korean output differed, and long Korean decode regressed slightly. Q6 read/layout and scratch expansion experiments also failed the speed-first criterion.

expert_decode_reuse_20261025.reason_not_deployed: Selective 1024-token ABBA medians improved by less than 0.5%; no established practical end-to-end gain. No persistent RAM reduction. The wider variant regressed on Korean generation.
expert_decode_reuse_20261025.correctness: 384 finite bit-exact expert subgraph combinations for each variant; selective sampled 1024-token outputs matched both repeats in both languages.

optimization_policy: Speed first for Flash and 27B. RAM savings are secondary; the owner permits negligible measured slowdowns. Do not lower weights/KV precision or context capacity.

dense_interleave_20261025.decision: Reject deployment: production-cost ABBA English median 44.05 -> 43.45 tok/s, Korean 34.35 -> 34.8. Both languages matched output hashes across all four arms. Fixed-cost-policy trials improved 1-2%, which did not establish a production gain.
dense_interleave_20261025.qualification: Selected finite bitwise checks and 16K input/1024 output trials only; filled 128K, vision and tools were not qualified for this candidate.

bf16_lossless_20261025.status: isolated prototype; not integrated or deployed
bf16_lossless_20261025.result: Two actual HC-down matrices, T=1..8: finite bitwise equality and about 8-16% less kernel time. Encoded down-only payload would save 130.169 MiB; no whole-model RAM or speed gain measured. Generic HC-up regressed and is rejected.
bf16_lossless_20261025.remaining: Replace loader representation and support prefill without retaining duplicate weights; qualify full inference before adoption.

reproduction.note: Offsets below are absolute bytes for the tested file. Re-derive from GGUF metadata for any other file. Benchmark supports only input width 10240 and output width 320. It intentionally holds eight raw and eight encoded copies to exceed L2; these allocations are not a production memory measurement.

hc_lossless_20261026.validation: 384 exact fused GPU cases; fixed ABBA outputs identical; 125K and image qualification passed. Decode unchanged, whole-machine RAM savings unconfirmed. Production unchanged.

native_projection_arena_20261026.decision: Hold. Short-context allocation savings did not hold consistently at 125K plus image. Candidate image-phase available-RAM minima were worse in both orders; production original restored.

prefill_hc_scratch_20261026.validation: 55 exact diagnostic requests; 32 timed requests/16 exact output pairs; 44 full-context/function requests and 10 image-follow-up requests passed. RAM benefit persisted near 129K and images. Small measured slowdown accepted. One earlier image latency outlier remains unexplained but did not recur in six follow-up images. Deployed with bounded API smoke, unchanged OMP process/session and zero new swap/OOM.
